verdict.rationale: Square documents a Disputes API with a 'Process Disputes' guide and dispute sandbox testing. Its official MCP server, which supports remote OAuth, explicitly lists disputes in its service catalog, so an agent can call dispute endpoints through make_api_request. The llms.txt agent guidance and webhook subscriptions support agentic workflows, but the pack shows only page titles and never documents the individual steps. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of retrieving disputes, uploading or assembling evidence, and submitting the response; hands-on or independent corroboration of an agent completing a dispute end-to-end.
